1.1: This right here is the revelation of Jesus Christ—the one God gave Him to show His servants what's 'bout to go down soon. Jesus sent it through an angel to His boy John.
1.2: John testified to everything he saw—God's word and what Jesus revealed. He kept it 100 the whole way.
1.3: Blessings to the one who reads this out loud, and to everybody who hears it and actually does what it says. Time ain't just near—it's knockin'.
1.4: From John—To the seven churches out in Asia: Grace and peace to y'all from the One who is, who was, and who's still comin', and from the seven Spirits posted up before His throne,
1.5: And from Jesus Christ—the faithful witness, the first to rise from the dead and never die again, and the true Ruler over every king on this earth. To Him who loved us and washed our sins clean with His own blood—
1.6: And made us kings and priests to God the Father—To Him be glory and authority forever. Amen. 👑
1.7: Look, He comin' with the clouds! Every eye gon' see Him—even the ones who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the world gon' mourn when they see Him. Yeah. Let it be. Amen.
1.8: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord—the Beginning and the End. "I'm the One who is, who was, and who's comin' back. I'm the Almighty." 🔥
1.9: It's me, John—y'all brother and teammate in the struggles, the Kingdom, and the patience of Jesus. I was exiled on the island of Patmos 'cause I stayed faithful to God's word and kept speakin' on Jesus.
1.10: One Sunday, I got caught up in the Spirit. And I heard a loud voice behind me—sounded like a trumpet blast—
1.11: Sayin', "I'm the Alpha and Omega—the First and the Last. Write what you see in a book and send it to the seven churches: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamos, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."
1.12: I turned to see who was talkin' to me. And when I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
1.13: And right in the middle was Somebody who looked like the Son of Man—rockin' a long robe and a golden sash across His chest.
1.14: His hair was white like wool—bright like snow—and His eyes were flames of fire.
1.15: His feet? Looked like polished bronze fresh out the furnace. His voice? Like a thousand waterfalls. 🌊
1.16: In His right hand, He held seven stars. Out His mouth came a sharp double-edged sword. And His face? Shinin' like the full-force sun.
1.17: When I saw Him, I dropped like I was dead. But He touched me with His right hand and said, "Don't be scared. I'm the First and the Last.
1.18: I'm the One who's alive. I was dead, but look—I'm alive forever now. Amen. And I hold the keys to death and the grave." 🔑
1.19: "So write down what you've seen, what's happenin' now, and what's gon' happen next."
1.20: "Here's the mystery: The seven stars in My right hand? They the angels (or messengers) of the seven churches. And the seven lampstands? That's the seven churches."

2.1: Write this to the angel of the church in Ephesus: This the One holdin' all seven stars in His right hand, walkin' in the middle of the seven golden lampstands—He got somethin' to say:
2.2: "I see your grind—your works, your hard labor, and your patience. I know you don't play when it comes to evil folks. You tested them fake apostles and called out the lies.
2.3: You stayed strong, didn't give up, and kept workin' for My name.
2.4: But I got somethin' against you: you fell off from your first love.
2.5: So check where you slipped. Repent. Get back to what you used to do, or I'm takin' your lampstand away—quick—unless you change.
2.6: One thing I do respect: you can't stand the Nicolaitan crew, and neither can I."
2.7: "Anybody who got ears? Listen up. Whoever overcomes—I'll let you eat from the Tree of Life in God's paradise." 🌴
2.8: To the angel of the church in Smyrna, write: This from the First and the Last—the One who died and came back to life:
2.9: "I know your works. I see your suffering and poverty—though you really rich in spirit. I know the ones talkin' like they Jews but ain't—just frontin'. They a synagogue of Satan.
2.10: Don't be scared of what's comin'. The devil about to test some of y'all by throwin' you in jail. You gon' face heat for ten days. Stay faithful—even if it kills you—and I'll crown you with life."
2.11: "If you got ears, hear what the Spirit is sayin'. Whoever overcomes ain't got nothin' to fear from the second death." 👑
2.12: To the angel of the church in Pergamos, write: This from the One who got the sharp double-edged sword:
2.13: "I know your works. I see where you live—that's Satan's neighborhood. Still, you held on to My name, and didn't switch up when Antipas, My faithful witness, got killed right where y'all at."
2.14: "But I do got a few things against you: Some of y'all messin' with the teachings of Balaam—lead people into sin, idol food, and sexual immorality.
2.15: And then there's some holdin' to the Nicolaitan teachings too, which I hate."
2.16: "Repent—or I'm pullin' up quick, and I ain't talkin'. I'm swingin' with the sword of My mouth."
2.17: "Whoever got ears—listen. Whoever overcomes? I got hidden manna for 'em and a white stone with a name on it—one that only they know." 🍞💎
2.18: To the angel of the church in Thyatira, write: This is from the Son of God—eyes like fire, feet like fine brass:
2.19: "I see your works. Your love, faith, service, and patience. Matter fact, you doin' more now than when you started."
2.20: "But I got beef with you—you lettin' that woman Jezebel run the show. She call herself a prophet, but she teachin' My people to get caught up in sex sin and idolatry."
2.21: "I gave her time to repent. She ain't take it."
2.22: "Now I'ma throw her in a sickbed. And the folks sleepin' with her? They headed for heavy trouble unless they repent."
2.23: "Her kids? I'ma strike 'em down. And the whole church gon' know—I'm the One who reads hearts and minds. And everybody gon' get what they deserve."
2.24: "But for the rest of y'all in Thyatira who ain't messed with that mess, who ain't studied 'Satan's deep secrets'—I won't put more on you.
2.25: Just hold tight to what you got—till I come."
2.26: "Whoever overcomes and keeps grindin' in My works to the end? I'ma give them authority over nations.
2.27: They gon' rule with iron like I do—breakin' pride like pottery."
2.29: "If you got ears? Listen to what the Spirit's sayin' to the churches."

3.1: To the angel of the church in Sardis, write: This is from the One who got the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. He say: "I know what y'all do. You got a name like you alive… but you spiritually dead."
3.2: "Wake up! Strengthen what little remains, 'cause it's about to die too. I checked your work and it ain't hittin' like it's supposed to—not perfect in God's sight."
3.3: "Remember what you heard. Go back to it. Hold tight and repent. If you don't wake up, I'm comin' for you like a thief in the night—you won't even see Me comin'."
3.4: "But some of y'all in Sardis kept your garments clean. Y'all gon' walk with Me in white 'cause you stayed worthy."
3.5: "Whoever overcomes will be dressed in white. And I won't erase their name from the Book of Life. I'll say their name out loud before My Father and all the angels." 🕊️
3.6: "If you got ears, hear what the Spirit sayin' to the churches."
3.7: To the angel of the church in Philly, write: This is from the One who's holy and true—the One who got the key of David. When He opens a door, can't nobody shut it. And when He shut it, it's shut for good. 🔐
3.8: "I see you. I know your works. I opened a door for you that no one can close. You ain't got much strength, but you kept My word. You ain't deny My name."
3.9: "Look, I'ma make those fake ones from the synagogue of Satan—who say they Jews but ain't—I'ma make them come and bow down at your feet. They gon' know I love you."
3.10: "Since you held tight to My command to keep goin', I'ma keep you too—from the hour of testing that's comin' for the whole world."
3.11: "I'm comin' quick. Hold on to what you got so nobody snatch your crown."
3.12: "Whoever overcomes, I'ma make them a pillar in God's temple. They ain't ever leavin'. I'ma write God's name on them, and the name of the New Jerusalem comin' down from heaven. And I'ma write My new name on them too." 🏛️✍️
3.13: "If you got ears, listen to what the Spirit sayin' to the churches."
3.14: To the angel of the church in Laodicea, write: This from the Amen—the faithful and true witness, the beginning of God's creation:
3.15: "I know your works. You ain't hot or cold. I wish you were one or the other.
3.16: But since you lukewarm—neither cold nor hot—I'ma spit you out My mouth." 😶‍🌫️
3.17: "You say, 'I'm rich. I got everything. I don't need a thing.' But you don't even realize—you wretched, miserable, broke, blind, and naked."
3.18: "Here's what I say: Buy real gold from Me—refined in fire—so you can actually be rich. Get white garments from Me to cover your shame. Put My eye salve on so you can really see."
3.19: "Everybody I love, I correct. So get serious. Turn around. Repent."
3.20: "I'm standin' at the door knockin'. If you hear Me and open up? I'ma come in and eat with you—and you with Me." 🍽️
3.21: "Whoever overcomes? You gon' sit with Me on My throne—just like I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne." 👑
3.22: "If you got ears, hear what the Spirit sayin' to the churches."

4.1: After all that, I looked up—and boom, there was a door wide open in heaven. And the same voice I heard before, soundin' like a trumpet, said, "Come up here, and I'ma show you what's about to happen next." 🔊
4.2: Just like that, I was in the Spirit. And what did I see? A throne set in heaven—and Somebody was sittin' on it. 👑
4.3: The One sittin' there? Shinin' like jasper and deep red like sardius stone. And all around the throne was a rainbow—lookin' like an emerald halo. 🌈💎
4.4: Surroundin' the main throne were 24 other thrones. And on those thrones? 24 elders, dressed in all white, with golden crowns on their heads.
4.5: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblin', and voices. And in front of it? Seven flames burnin'—that's the seven Spirits of God on full display. 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥
4.6: In front of the throne was a sea—clear like crystal glass. And right in the middle of the throne, all around it, were four living creatures—covered in eyes, front and back. 👁️👁️👁️
4.7: The first creature looked like a lion. The second looked like a calf. The third had a face like a man. The fourth was like a flying eagle. 🦁🐂👤🦅
4.8: Each creature had six wings, covered in eyes all over. And they never rest, day or night, sayin': "Holy, holy, holy Lord God Almighty, Who was, who is, and who's still to come!"
4.9: Every time the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One sittin' on the throne—who lives forever and ever—
4.10: The 24 elders drop off their thrones, fall flat before Him, and worship the Eternal One. Then they take their crowns off and throw 'em down at His feet, sayin':
4.11: "You are worthy, Lord, To receive all the glory, honor, and power. You made everything. And everything exists 'cause You wanted it to." 🙌🏾👑

5.1: Then I saw in the right hand of the One sittin' on the throne a scroll. It had writing on the inside and the back—and it was sealed up tight with seven seals. 📜
5.2: Then a strong angel stepped up and shouted loud: "Who's worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?"
5.3: But nobody—nobody—in heaven, on earth, or under the earth could open it. Couldn't even look at it.
5.4: That broke me. I started cryin' hard. 'Cause nobody was worthy to open or read the scroll.
5.5: But one of the elders leaned over and said, "Stop cryin'. Look! The Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David—He done overcame. He's worthy to open the scroll and break all seven seals." 🦁🔥
5.6: Then I looked—and in the middle of the throne, surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders, I saw Him: A Lamb standing there like He had just been slain. He had seven horns and seven eyes—that's the seven Spirits of God, sent out across the earth.
5.7: And He walked up and took the scroll from the right hand of the One sittin' on the throne. 👑✋🏾
5.8: Soon as the Lamb took the scroll, the four living creatures and the 24 elders fell down before Him. Each of them had a harp and golden bowls full of incense—those are the prayers of the saints. 🎶🔥
5.9: And they broke into a new song, singin': "You are worthy to take the scroll And break its seals, 'Cause You were slain— And with Your blood, You bought us for God From every tribe, every language, every people, every nation."
5.10: "You made us kings and priests to our God, And we gon' reign on the earth!" 🌍👑
5.11: Then I looked again—and heard voices of angels everywhere, circlin' the throne, the creatures, and the elders. There were thousands times thousands—like, too many to count. 📣
5.12: And they shouted loud: "Worthy is the Lamb who was slain To receive power, wealth, wisdom, Strength, honor, glory, and blessing!" 🙌🏾
5.13: Then I heard every creature—in heaven, on earth, under the earth, even in the sea—every last one of 'em sayin': "Blessing, honor, glory, and power To the One who sits on the throne, And to the Lamb—forever and ever!"
5.14: The four living creatures shouted, "Amen!" And the 24 elders dropped down and worshiped Him—the One who lives forever and ever. 🙇🏾‍♂️🙇🏽‍♀️

6.1: I watched as the Lamb opened the first seal. One of the four living creatures shouted with a voice like thunder: "Come and see!"
6.2: And I looked—and there was a white horse. The rider had a bow. A crown was given to him. And he rode out—conquering and ready to conquer. 🏹👑
6.3: The Lamb broke the second seal. The second living creature said, "Come and see!"
6.4: Then came a red horse. The rider was given power to take peace from the earth, so people would start killin' each other. He was handed a big sword. 🗡️🔥
6.5: When the third seal broke, I heard the third living creature say, "Come and see!" I looked and saw a black horse. The rider held a pair of scales in his hand. ⚖️
6.6: Then I heard a voice near the creatures say: "A quart of wheat for a day's pay. Three quarts of barley for a day's pay. But don't touch the oil or the wine."
6.7: When the fourth seal opened, the fourth creature said, "Come and see!"
6.8: I looked—and saw a pale horse. The rider's name? Death. And right behind him? Hades. They were given power to kill a quarter of the earth—with the sword, with famine, with disease, and even with wild animals. 💀👣
6.9: When the Lamb broke the fifth seal, I saw souls under the altar—those who had been killed for God's word and for holdin' down their testimony.
6.10: They cried out loud: "How long, Lord—holy and true—until You judge and avenge us?"
6.11: Each one was given a white robe and told to rest a little longer, until their fellow servants and brothers who'd also be killed had joined them.
6.12: When He broke the sixth seal, I looked—and everything started shiftin': There was a massive earthquake. The sun turned black like sackcloth. The moon turned red like blood. 🌑🌕
6.13: Stars fell like figs off a tree in the wind.
6.14: The sky rolled up like a scroll, and every mountain and island moved outta place.
6.15: All the people—kings, rulers, rich folks, military leaders, the powerful, the broke, and the free—ran for cover. They hid in caves and under rocks.
6.16: And they shouted: "Fall on us! Hide us from the face of the One on the throne—and from the wrath of the Lamb!"
6.17: "The great day of His wrath has come—and who can stand?" 😱

7.1: After all that, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holdin' the four winds back, so they couldn't blow on the earth, the sea, or even mess with the trees. 🌬️
7.2: Then another angel showed up, comin' from the east, holdin' the seal of the living God. He yelled out loud to the four angels who had the power to mess up the earth and the sea:
7.3: "Don't do no damage to the earth, sea, or trees yet—until we seal the servants of our God on their foreheads."
7.4: I heard how many were sealed—144,000 from all the tribes of Israel:
7.5: From the tribe of Judah, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Reuben, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Gad, 12,000 were sealed.
7.6: From the tribe of Asher, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Naphtali, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Manasseh, 12,000 were sealed.
7.7: From the tribe of Simeon, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Levi, 12,000 were sealed.
7.8: From the tribe of Issachar, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Zebulun, 12,000 were sealed. From the tribe of Joseph, 12,000 were sealed. And from the tribe of Benjamin, 12,000 were sealed.
7.9: After this, I looked, and behold—there was a huge crowd. You couldn't even count 'em. From all nations, tribes, people, and languages—standin' before the throne and the Lamb. They were all dressed in white robes, holdin' palm branches in their hands. 🌿
7.10: And they shouted loud: "Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, And to the Lamb!"
7.11: All the angels stood around the throne, and the elders, and the four living creatures, fell down on their faces and worshiped God,
7.12: sayin': "Amen! Blessin' and glory and wisdom, Thanksgiving and honor, and power and might, Be to our God forever and ever. Amen."
7.13: One of the elders turned to me and asked: "Who are these folks dressed in white robes? Where'd they come from?"
7.14: I said to him, "You know, sir." And he answered me: "These are the ones who came outta the great tribulation. They washed their robes and made 'em white in the blood of the Lamb."
7.15: "Because of that, they're before the throne of God, servin' Him day and night in His temple. And the One sittin' on the throne gon' live with them."
7.16: "They won't be hungry no more, or thirsty no more. The sun won't beat down on them, or the heat either." 🌞
7.17: "The Lamb, who's right there in the middle of the throne, will shepherd them and lead them to fountains of living water. And God will wipe every tear from their eyes." 🐑💧

8.1: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, everything went quiet—like, for about half an hour. That silence in heaven? It was heavy.
8.2: Then I saw the seven angels who stand before God. They were handed seven trumpets. 🎺
8.3: Then another angel showed up, with a golden censer. He stood at the altar, and he had a whole lot of incense. He was told to offer it with the prayers of the saints, puttin' it on the golden altar before the throne.
8.4: The smoke from the incense, along with the prayers of the saints, went up to God. That's a sweet aroma in the presence of God—straight from the angel's hand.
8.5: Then the angel grabbed the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it to the earth. Boom! There were noises, thunder, lightning, and a massive earthquake. ⚡🌍
8.6: Then the seven angels with the trumpets got themselves ready to blow.
8.7: The first angel sounded the trumpet: And hail and fire came down, mixed with blood. It was thrown to the earth, and a third of the trees got burned up—all the green grass got burned too. 🌿🔥
8.8: The second angel sounded: And something like a huge mountain, burnin' with fire, was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood. 🌊🔥
8.9: A third of the creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
8.10: The third angel sounded: And a big star fell from heaven, burnin' like a torch. It landed on a third of the rivers and springs of water.
8.11: The name of that star? Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter—people died from drinkin' it. 😷
8.12: The fourth angel sounded: And a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars. A third of the daylight went dark, and the night? Same thing. 🌑🌒
8.13: Then I looked, and I heard an angel flyin' in the middle of heaven, shoutin' loud: "Woe, woe, woe to the people on earth. The next three trumpets are about to be worse than these!" 😱

9.1: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from heaven to earth. And to him was given the key to the bottomless pit.
9.2: He opened the pit, and smoke poured out like the smoke of a giant furnace. The sun and the air got dark 'cause of the smoke from the pit. 🌪️
9.3: Out the smoke came locusts on the earth. They were given power, like scorpions.
9.4: But they were told not to touch the grass, trees, or green things—only the people who didn't have God's seal on their foreheads.
9.5: They couldn't kill 'em, but they could torment them for five months. The torment was like what happens when a scorpion stings a man—painful, constant.
9.6: People gon' try to die, but won't be able to. They gon' want to die, but death gon' run from them. 😣
9.7: The locusts looked like horses ready for battle. They wore crowns that looked like gold. Their faces were like men's faces.
9.8: They had hair like women's hair, and their teeth? Like lion's teeth. 🦁
9.9: They wore breastplates like iron, and when they flapped their wings, it sounded like chariots with horses runnin' into battle. 🐎🎶
9.10: They had tails like scorpions, and their tails had stingers. They could hurt people for five months.
9.11: And they had a king over them—the angel of the bottomless pit. His name in Hebrew was Abaddon. In Greek, his name was Apollyon.
9.12: One woe is past, but wait—two more are comin' after this.
9.13: When the sixth angel blew his trumpet, I heard a voice from the four corners of the golden altar, which is before God,
9.14: Sayin' to the sixth angel: "Release the four angels bound at the Euphrates River."
9.15: So the four angels, who'd been prepped for the hour, day, month, and year, were let loose to kill a third of mankind.
9.16: The army of horsemen? Two hundred million strong. I heard the number.
9.17: And I saw the horses in the vision: The ones ridin' them had breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow. The horses' heads looked like lions' heads, and fire, smoke, and brimstone came outta their mouths.
9.18: With these three plagues—fire, smoke, and brimstone—a third of mankind was killed.
9.19: Their power was in their mouths and their tails. Their tails were like serpents, with heads on 'em, and they used 'em to do harm. 🐍🔥
9.20: But the rest of the people who weren't killed by these plagues? They didn't repent. They didn't stop worshipping demons and idols made of gold, silver, brass, stone, and wood—stuff that couldn't see, hear, or move.
9.21: And they didn't repent of their murders, sorceries, sexual immorality, or thefts. 💀🔮

10.1: I saw another angel—big energy—comin' down from heaven. He was covered in a cloud, with a rainbow on his head. His face shone like the sun, and his feet were like pillars of fire. 🌈🔥
10.2: He had a little book in his hand, all open and ready. He stood with one foot on the sea and the other on the land. 🌊🌍
10.3: And he cried out loud—like a lion roar. When he did, seven thunders spoke up and uttered their voices.
10.4: I was about to write what they said, but I heard a voice from heaven say, "Seal up what the seven thunders said. Don't write it down." 🤐
10.5: The angel who was standin' on the sea and land lifted his hand to heaven
10.6: And swore by the One who lives forever, who made the heavens, the earth, and the sea— "Time is up. There ain't no more delay. When the seventh angel sounds, the mystery of God will be done—just like He told His prophets."
10.7: When the seventh angel starts blowin' his trumpet, the mystery of God will be finished, just like He promised His servants the prophets.
10.8: Then I heard a voice from heaven speak to me again, sayin': "Go and take the little book from the angel's hand—the one standin' on the sea and land."
10.9: So I went to the angel and asked him, "Give me the little book." He said, "Take it and eat it. It's gon' taste sweet like honey in your mouth, but once it hits your stomach, it'll turn bitter." 🍯😖
10.10: So I took the book from the angel's hand, ate it—and it was sweet like honey in my mouth. But once it hit my stomach, it turned bitter.
10.11: Then he said to me, "Now you gotta prophesy again about many peoples, nations, tongues, and kings."

11.1: Then I was given a reed like a measuring rod. The angel told me, "Get up and measure the temple of God, the altar, and those worshiping there."
11.2: But don't mess with the outer court—it's been given to the Gentiles. They gon' tread on the holy city for 42 months. 🕰️
11.3: I'ma give power to My two witnesses—they gon' prophesy for 1,260 days, wearin' sackcloth.
11.4: These two are the two olive trees and two lampstands standin' before the God of the earth. 🌿🕯️
11.5: If anybody try to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and burns their enemies. And if anybody tries to hurt them? They get handled that way.
11.6: These two witnesses got the power to shut up heaven so no rain falls during their prophecy. They can turn waters into blood and hit the earth with all kinds of plagues whenever they want. 🔥💧
11.7: But once they finish their testimony, the beast that comes from the bottomless pit will make war with them, beat them, and kill them.
11.8: And their bodies gon' lie in the street of the great city. That city's spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, the same place where our Lord was crucified.
11.9: People from every nation, tribe, language, and tongue gon' see their dead bodies for three-and-a-half days. They won't even bury them—just leave them out in the street. 😔
11.10: And folks on earth gon' be happy. They gon' celebrate, make merry, and exchange gifts with each other—'cause these two prophets made life hard for them.
11.11: But after three-and-a-half days, the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood up on their feet. Everybody who saw it? They got shook.
11.12: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven sayin', "Come up here!" And they rose up to heaven in a cloud, and their enemies watched them.
11.13: Right when that happened, there was a great earthquake. A tenth of the city fell. 7,000 people were killed in the quake. The rest got scared and gave glory to God in heaven.
11.14: The second woe is over, but look—the third woe comin' quick.
11.15: Then the seventh angel blew his trumpet. And there were loud voices in heaven, sayin', "The kingdoms of this world have now become the kingdoms of our Lord and His Christ, And He gon' reign forever and ever!" 👑
11.16: The 24 elders who sat before God on their thrones fell on their faces and worshiped God,
11.17: Sayin': "We thank You, Lord God Almighty, The One who is, who was, and who's comin', 'Cause You took Your great power and started reignin'."
11.18: "The nations were mad, but Your wrath has come. It's time for the dead to be judged, To reward Your prophets, Your saints, And those who fear Your name—big or small— And to destroy those who destroy the earth." 🌍💥
11.19: Then the temple of God was opened in heaven, and the ark of the covenant was seen in His temple. There were lightnings, thunder, noises, an earthquake, and hail. 🌩️

12.1: I saw a big sign up in heaven—a woman, clothed with the sun, the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown made of twelve stars. 🌞🌙⭐
12.2: And she was pregnant—cryin' out in labor, in pain, ready to give birth.
12.3: Then I saw another sign—this time, a fiery red dragon. He had seven heads, ten horns, and seven crowns on his heads. 🔥🐉👑
12.4: His tail swiped a third of the stars in heaven and threw them down to the earth. The dragon stood right in front of the woman, ready to snatch her baby as soon as it was born.
12.5: She gave birth to a son, a male child who was supposed to rule all nations with a rod of iron. And the child was taken up to God and His throne. 👶🏾👑
12.6: Then the woman took off to the wilderness, to a place God had prepared for her, where she'd be fed and taken care of for 1,260 days—that's about three and a half years.
12.7: Then war broke out in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
12.8: But they couldn't win. They couldn't even find a place for themselves in heaven anymore.
12.9: So the great dragon, that old serpent called the Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world, was thrown down to earth, along with his angels. 💥😈
12.10: Then I heard a loud voice in heaven shoutin', "Now salvation has come, strength has come, the kingdom of our God and the power of His Christ— 'Cause the accuser of our brothers and sisters, the one who accused them day and night before God, has been thrown down." 🎉👑
12.11: "They overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony. They didn't even love their lives so much as to shy away from death."
12.12: "So rejoice, heavens! All y'all who dwell in them, rejoice! But woe to the earth and sea! The devil's come down to you, and he mad—real mad—'cause he knows his time is short." ⏳
12.13: When the dragon saw that he got thrown down to the earth, he went after the woman who gave birth to the male child.
12.14: But the woman was given two wings of an eagle, so she could fly into the wilderness to her place, where she would be nourished for a time, times, and half a time (that's three and a half years) from the presence of the serpent.
12.15: The serpent tried to drown her by spewing water out of his mouth, like a flood, to carry her away with the current. 🌊
12.16: But the earth helped her. The earth opened up its mouth and swallowed the flood the dragon shot out of his mouth.
12.17: The dragon got so mad at the woman, he went off to make war with the rest of her children—those who keep God's commandments and have the testimony of Jesus. 💣

13.1: I stood on the shore by the sea, and I saw this beast come out of the water. It had seven heads, ten horns, and ten crowns on its horns. And on its heads was a blasphemous name. 🐉👑
13.2: The beast looked like a leopard, but its feet were like a bear's, and its mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and all this authority. 🔥
13.3: One of its heads seemed to have been mortally wounded, but the deadly wound was healed. And the whole world was amazed and followed the beast.
13.4: So they worshiped the dragon who gave power to the beast, and they worshiped the beast itself, saying, "Who's like the beast? Who can fight him?" 🏆
13.5: The beast was given a mouth that spoke proud words and blasphemies, and it was allowed to continue like this for 42 months—a little over three years.
13.6: Then it opened its mouth and spoke blasphemy against God—against His name, His temple, and those who live in heaven.
13.7: It was given authority to make war on the saints and overcome them. And authority was given to it over every tribe, tongue, and nation.
13.8: Everybody on earth gon' worship the beast—except for those whose names are written in the Book of Life, the Lamb who was slain from the foundation of the world. 🌍
13.9: If you got ears, listen up.
13.10: Whoever leads others into captivity will go into captivity. Whoever kills with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here's the patience and faith of the saints. 🛡️
13.11: Then I saw another beast rise up from the earth. It had two horns like a lamb but spoke like a dragon. 🐏🐉
13.12: This beast had all the authority of the first beast and used it to make the people worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
13.13: It performed great signs, even makin' fire come down from heaven on earth in front of people. 🔥
13.14: It used these signs to deceive people, tellin' them to make an image of the beast who was wounded by the sword but lived.
13.15: The beast was given power to give breath to the image of the first beast, so it could speak. And anyone who refused to worship it was to be killed.
13.16: This beast made everyone—big or small, rich or poor, free or slave—take a mark on their right hand or forehead.
13.17: No one could buy or sell unless they had the mark, the name of the beast, or the number of its name. 💳
13.18: Here's where wisdom comes in: If you got understanding, calculate the number of the beast. It's the number of a man. His number is 666. 🔢

14.1: Then I looked, and behold—there was the Lamb standin' on Mount Zion, with 144,000 people with His Father's name written on their foreheads.
14.2: I heard a voice from heaven, like the sound of many waters, and like thunder. I also heard the sound of harps—harpists playin' their harps. 🎶🌊
14.3: They were singin' a new song before the throne, before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song except the 144,000 who were redeemed from the earth.
14.4: These are the ones who weren't defiled with women—'cause they stayed pure, virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever He goes. They were redeemed from among people, the firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.
14.5: They don't lie in their mouth—they're without fault in front of God's throne. Straight clean.
14.6: Then I saw another angel flyin' in the middle of heaven, holdin' the everlasting gospel to preach to the people on earth—every nation, tribe, tongue, and people.
14.7: He said with a loud voice, "Fear God and give glory to Him—'cause His judgment hour has come! Worship Him, the One who made heaven, earth, the sea, and the springs of water." 🌍🌊
14.8: Another angel followed, shoutin', "Babylon is fallen! The great city is fallen, 'cause she made all the nations drink the wine of her wrathful sin!" 🍷
14.9: Then a third angel followed them, sayin' loud: "If anybody worships the beast and his image, and gets that mark on their forehead or hand—
14.10: They gon' drink the wine of God's wrath, pure and uncut, in the cup of His anger. They gon' be tormented with fire and brimstone in front of the holy angels and the Lamb.
14.11: The smoke of their torment will rise forever. No rest for them, day or night—those who worship the beast, his image, or take the mark of his name."
14.12: Here's the patience of the saints—those who keep God's commandments and hold tight to their faith in Jesus. 🙏🏾
14.13: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, "Write this down: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on." "Yes," says the Spirit, "that they may rest from their labor, and their works follow them." 😇
14.14: Then I looked, and behold—a white cloud. On that cloud, someone like the Son of Man sat, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.
14.15: Another angel came out of the temple, shoutin' to the One sittin' on the cloud, "Thrust in Your sickle and reap—It's time to harvest the earth, 'cause it's ripe."
14.16: So the One on the cloud threw His sickle, and the earth was reaped.
14.17: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven, also with a sharp sickle.
14.18: And another angel, this one from the altar, who had power over fire, cried out loud to the one with the sickle: "Thrust in your sickle and gather the grapes of the earth, 'cause the vine of the earth is ripe!"
14.19: So the angel thrust his sickle into the earth and gathered the vine, throwin' the grapes into the great winepress of God's wrath.
14.20: The winepress was trampled outside the city, and blood came outta the press, up to the horses' bridles—for about 1,600 furlongs (that's a long stretch, fam). 🍇🩸

15.1: Then I saw another big sign in heaven—great and marvelous: Seven angels with the seven last plagues. In them? God's wrath is about to be complete. 🔥
15.2: Then I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire. And the people who had victory over the beast, his image, his mark, and the number of his name were standin' on the sea of glass, with harps of God in their hands.
15.3: And they were singin' the song of Moses, God's servant, and the song of the Lamb, sayin': "Great and marvelous are Your works, Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the saints!
15.4: Who wouldn't fear You, Lord, and give You glory? You're the only one holy. All nations gon' come and worship before You, 'Cause Your judgments been made clear." 🎶
15.5: After that, I looked and saw the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven open. 🔑
15.6: And outta the temple came the seven angels, all ready to bring the plagues. They were dressed in clean, bright linen, and had golden bands across their chests. ✨
15.7: Then one of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels seven golden bowls, filled with the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
15.8: The temple was so full of smoke from God's glory and power, no one could enter it until the seven plagues from the seven angels were finished. 🌫️

16.1: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple say to the seven angels, "Go and pour out the bowls of God's wrath on the earth."
16.2: The first angel went and poured his bowl on the earth, and painful, nasty sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped his image. 🤢
16.3: The second angel poured his bowl on the sea, and it turned to blood, like the blood of a dead man. And every living creature in the sea died. 🦑💀
16.4: The third angel poured his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they turned to blood.
16.5: And I heard the angel of the waters say: "You are righteous, Lord—The One who is, who was, and who is to be. You judged these things right, 'Cause they shed the blood of Your saints and prophets. Now You gave them blood to drink. It's what they deserve." 🍷
16.6: And I heard another voice from the altar say: "Yes, Lord God Almighty—true and righteous are Your judgments."
16.7: So, another voice from the altar speaks out: "For real, God, the Almighty, You straight up righteous with all these judgments You're bringing. No cap, You've been true every step of the way."
16.8: The fourth angel poured his bowl on the sun, and power was given to him to scorch men with fire.
16.9: People were scorched with intense heat, and they blasphemed God who has power over the plagues. But they still didn't repent or give Him glory. 😡🔥
16.10: The fifth angel poured his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom became full of darkness. People were in so much pain, they gnawed their tongues.
16.11: They blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pain and sores, but still, they didn't repent of what they were doin'. 😖
16.12: The sixth angel poured his bowl on the Euphrates River, and the water dried up, so that the way for the kings from the east could be made ready.
16.13: Then I saw three unclean spirits like frogs comin' out of the mouth of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet.
16.14: They were demonic spirits performin' signs, goin' to the kings of the earth and the whole world, gatherin' them for the great battle of God Almighty.
16.15: Then the voice said, "Look, I'm comin' like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays watchful and keeps their clothes on, so they don't walk around naked and ashamed."
16.16: And they gathered the armies together in a place called Armageddon. ⚔️🌍
16.17: Then the seventh angel poured his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came from the temple of heaven, from the throne, sayin', "It is done!"
16.18: There were noises, thunder, lightning, and a massive earthquake—one that's never been seen before. So strong, no earthquake like it had ever hit the earth.
16.19: The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Great Babylon was remembered before God, and He gave her the cup of His wrath.
16.20: Every island ran away, and the mountains couldn't be found. 🌊🏔️
16.21: Hail—huge and heavy—fell from heaven. Each hailstone weighed as much as a talent (that's real heavy). People blasphemed God because of the hailstorm, but that plague was just too much to bear.

17.1: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls came and spoke to me. He said, "Come, I'm about to show you the judgment of the great harlot who sits on many waters."
17.2: She's the one the kings of the earth have committed fornication with, and the people on earth got drunk off the wine of her sin. 🍷🔥
17.3: The angel carried me in the Spirit out to the wilderness, and I saw a woman sittin' on a scarlet beast. The beast had names of blasphemy all over it, with seven heads and ten horns.
17.4: The woman was decked out in purple and scarlet, wearin' gold, precious stones, and pearls. She had a golden cup in her hand, filled with abominations and the filth of her fornication.
17.5: And on her forehead, there was a name written: "MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH." 😱
17.6: I saw the woman, and she was drunk with the blood of the saints and the blood of those who were martyred for Jesus. When I saw her, I was shook—I marveled with great amazement.
17.7: But the angel asked me, "Why you shocked? I'm about to break down the mystery of the woman and the beast she rides on—the one with the seven heads and ten horns."
17.8: "The beast you saw was, and is not, and will rise outta the bottomless pit and go to destruction. Those on earth whose names aren't written in the Book of Life from the beginning of the world, they gon' be amazed when they see this beast that was, is not, and yet will be."
17.9: "Here's the wisdom, though: The seven heads are seven mountains the woman sits on."
17.10: "There are also seven kings: five have already fallen, one is, and one is yet to come. When he does come, he gon' rule for a short time."
17.11: "The beast that was, and is not, is the eighth king. He's part of the seven, and he's headed straight to destruction." 💀
17.12: "The ten horns you saw? They are ten kings who ain't got no kingdom yet. But for one hour, they gonna have power, and they'll rule with the beast."
17.13: "These kings are on the same page, and they gon' give their power to the beast."
17.14: "These kings will make war with the Lamb, but the Lamb will defeat them. He's the Lord of lords, King of kings, and those who ride with Him are called, chosen, and faithful." 👑
17.15: The angel said to me, "The waters you saw, where the harlot sits, represent people, multitudes, nations, and tongues." 🌊
17.16: "And the ten horns on the beast? They gon' hate the harlot. They gon' make her desolate and naked, eat her flesh, and burn her with fire." 🔥💀
17.17: "God has put it in their hearts to carry out His purpose, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast—until God's words are fulfilled."
17.18: "And the woman you saw? That's the great city that rules over the kings of the earth." 🌍

18.1: After all this, I saw another angel comin' down from heaven, with mad authority, and the whole earth lit up with his glory.
18.2: He cried out loud with a strong voice, sayin', "Babylon the great has fallen, has fallen, and has turned into a place where demons live, a prison for every dirty spirit, and a cage for every unclean and hated bird!"
18.3: All the nations have drunk the wine of her bad ways, the kings of the earth have slept with her, and the merchants of the earth have gotten rich off all her luxury.
18.4: I heard another voice from heaven sayin', "Come outta her, my people, so you don't share in her sins, or end up sufferin' her plagues."
18.5: Her sins have reached all the way up to heaven, and God ain't forgot what she did.
18.6: Pay her back just like she paid y'all—give her double for what she did. Whatever cup she mixed, mix double for her.
18.7: Since she glorified herself and lived large, give her the same torment and sorrow. She says in her heart, "I'm a queen, I ain't no widow, I won't see no sorrow."
18.8: Her plagues gon' hit her all at once—death, mourning, and famine. She gon' be burned up with fire, 'cause the Lord God, the one who judges her, is mad strong.
18.9: The kings of the earth who messed with her, livin' large with her, gon' cry and mourn when they see her burnin' up.
18.10: They gon' be standin' far away, scared of what's happenin' to her, cryin', "Man, man, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! In just one hour, your judgment hit."
18.11: And the merchants of the earth gon' mourn, cryin' 'cause ain't nobody buyin' their stuff no more:
18.12: Merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, every kind of citron wood, every kind of ivory, every kind of precious wood, bronze, iron, and marble;
18.13: And cinnamon, incense, fragrant oils, and frankincense, wine and oil, fine flour and wheat, cattle and sheep, horses and chariots, and bodies and souls of men.
18.14: The fruit that your soul wanted so bad is gone, and all the rich and fancy things are gone from you, and you ain't gonna find them no more.
18.15: The merchants of all this stuff, who got rich off her, gon' stand far away, scared of her torment, cryin' and wailin'.
18.16: And they gon' be sayin', "Man, man, that great city, dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, with gold, precious stones, and pearls!
18.17: For in just one hour, all that great wealth came to nothin'." Every shipmaster, all who travel by ship, sailors, and all who trade on the sea, stood far away.
18.18: They cried out when they saw the smoke of her burnin', sayin', "What's like this great city?"
18.19: They threw dust on their heads and cried out, weepin' and wailin', sayin', "Man, man, that great city, where all who had ships on the sea got rich from her wealth! In just one hour, she's done for."
18.20: Rejoice over her, heaven, and you holy apostles and prophets, 'cause God has got back at her for y'all!
18.21: Then a mighty angel grabbed a stone like a big millstone and threw it into the sea, sayin', "Just like that, with violence, that great city Babylon will be thrown down, and you won't find her anymore."
18.22: Ain't no more music gon' be heard in you—no harp players, musicians, flutists, or trumpeters. Ain't no craftsman of any kind gonna be found in you anymore, and you won't hear the sound of a millstone in you no more.
18.23: Ain't no light gonna shine in you anymore, and you won't hear the bridegroom and bride in you anymore. For your merchants were the big shots on earth, and by your magic, all the nations were deceived.
18.24: And in her was found the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who were killed on the earth.

19.1: After all this, I heard a loud voice from a big crowd in heaven sayin', "Hallelujah! Salvation, glory, honor, and power belong to our God!"
19.2: 'Cause His judgments are true and righteous—He judged that big harlot who messed up the earth with her ways, and He got revenge for the blood of His servants she killed.
19.3: Again they said, "Hallelujah! Her smoke rises up forever and ever!"
19.4: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sat on the throne, sayin', "Amen! Hallelujah!"
19.5: Then a voice came from the throne sayin', "Praise our God, all you servants of His and those who fear Him, both small and great!"
19.6: Then I heard, like, a great crowd, soundin' like many waters and thunder, sayin', "Hallelujah! For the Lord God Omnipotent reigns!"
19.7: Let's be glad and rejoice, and give Him glory, for the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His wife has made herself ready.
19.8: She's got on fine linen, clean and bright, 'cause that linen is the righteous deeds of the saints.
19.9: Then the angel said to me, "Write this down: 'Blessed are those who are called to the marriage supper of the Lamb!'" And he told me, "These are the true sayings of God."
19.10: I fell down at his feet to worship him, but he said, "Nah, don't do that! I'm your fellow servant, and one of your brothers who testify about Jesus. Worship God! 'Cause the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."
19.11: Then I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse. The one who was ridin' it was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness, He judges and makes war.
19.12: His eyes were like a flame of fire, and on His head were many crowns. He had a name written that only He knew.
19.13: He was wearin' a robe dipped in blood, and His name is called The Word of God.
19.14: The armies in heaven, dressed in fine linen, clean and white, followed Him on white horses.
19.15: From His mouth came a sharp sword that He could use to strike the nations. He'll rule them with a rod of iron, and He treads the winepress of the wrath of Almighty God.
19.16: On His robe and thigh, He had a name written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
19.17: Then I saw an angel standin' in the sun, and he cried with a loud voice, sayin' to all the birds flyin' in the sky, "Come, gather together for the supper of the great God,
19.18: so y'all can eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, the flesh of horses and those who sit on 'em, and the flesh of all people, free and slave, small and great."
19.19: And I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies gathered to make war against the one sittin' on the white horse and His army.
19.20: The beast was captured, and with him, the false prophet who had done signs in his presence to deceive those who had taken the mark of the beast and worshiped his image. They were both thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with brimstone.
19.21: And the rest were killed with the sword that came out of the mouth of the one sittin' on the horse. All the birds ate their flesh.

20.1: Then I saw an angel comin' down from heaven. He had the key to the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand. 🔑⛓️
20.2: The angel grabbed the dragon, that old serpent—the Devil and Satan—and bound him for a thousand years.
20.3: He threw him into the bottomless pit, locked it up, and sealed it, so Satan couldn't deceive the nations anymore. But after that thousand years, he gon' be released for a little while.
20.4: Then I saw thrones, and people sittin' on them. Judgment was given to them. I also saw the souls of those who'd been beheaded for their witness to Jesus and the word of God. They didn't worship the beast, or his image, or take his mark on their foreheads or hands. 🛡️
20.5: They came back to life and reigned with Christ for 1,000 years.
20.6: But the rest of the dead didn't come to life until after the thousand years were finished. This right here is the first resurrection. Blessed and holy is the one who has part in the first resurrection. Over them, the second death has no power. They gon' be priests of God and of Christ, and reign with Him for a thousand years. 🙌🏾👑
20.7: When the thousand years are up, Satan gon' be released from his prison.
20.8: He gon' go out and deceive the nations at the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog—gatherin' them for battle. Their number gon' be like the sand of the sea. 🌍⚔️
20.9: They'll surround the camp of the saints and the beloved city. But fire gon' come down from God outta heaven and burn them up. 🔥
20.10: The devil, who deceived them, gon' be thrown into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet already are. They gon' be tormented day and night, forever and ever. 💥🔥
20.11: Then I saw a great white throne and the One who sat on it. When He sat down, the earth and the heaven ran away—they had no place to hide.
20.12: I saw the dead, from the smallest to the greatest, standin' before God. And books were opened. Another book was opened too—the Book of Life. The dead were judged based on what was written in the books, according to their works. 📖
20.13: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. And they were judged, each one based on their works. 🌊⚰️
20.14: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death. 💀🔥
20.15: Anyone whose name wasn't found in the Book of Life was thrown into the lake of fire. 🔥

21.1: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, 'cause the first heaven and the first earth had passed away. There ain't no more sea. 🌍🌊
21.2: And I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, comin' down outta heaven from God, dressed up like a bride ready for her husband. 💍
21.3: I heard a loud voice from heaven sayin', "Look, God's tabernacle is with people! He's gon' dwell with them, and they gon' be His people. God Himself gon' be with them and be their God."
21.4: "God gon' wipe away every tear from their eyes. There won't be no more death, no sorrow, no cryin'. No more pain. The old stuff is gone." 💧😢❌
21.5: Then the One sittin' on the throne said, "Look, I'm makin' everything new." And He told me, "Write this down, these words are true and faithful." ✍🏾
21.6: "It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give the water of life freely to those who thirst." 🌊🍃
21.7: "Whoever overcomes will inherit all things. I will be their God, and they gon' be My children."
21.8: "But the cowardly, unbelieving, the vile, murderers, the sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars—they gon' have their part in the lake that burns with fire and brimstone. That's the second death." 💀🔥
21.9: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls of plagues came and spoke to me, sayin', "Come, I'm gon' show you the bride, the Lamb's wife." 💒
21.10: He took me in the Spirit to a high mountain and showed me the great city, the holy Jerusalem, comin' down out of heaven from God.
21.11: The city had God's glory—its light was like a precious stone, like jasper, clear as crystal. 💎✨
21.12: The city had a great, high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates were twelve angels, and names written on the gates, the names of the twelve tribes of Israel. 🏙️
21.13: Three gates were on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west. 🏰
21.14: The wall had twelve foundations, and on them were the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb. 🏛️
21.15: The angel who spoke to me had a gold reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.
21.16: The city was laid out like a square, with its length and width both 12,000 furlongs (about 1,500 miles). Its length, width, and height were all the same. 🏙️📏
21.17: The wall was 144 cubits (about 200 feet), according to the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
21.18: The wall was made of jasper, and the city itself was pure gold, like clear glass. 🌟💰
21.19: The foundations of the city walls were adorned with all kinds of precious stones: jasper, sapphire, chalcedony, emerald, sardonyx, sardius, chrysolite, beryl, topaz, chrysoprase, jacinth, and amethyst. 💎💎💎
21.20: The twelve gates were twelve pearls—each gate made from a single pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass. 🦪💎
21.21: The twelve gates were twelve pearls—each gate made from a single pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass. 🦪💎
21.22: I didn't see no temple in the city, 'cause the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple. 🏛️
21.23: The city didn't need the sun or the moon to shine, 'cause God's glory lit it up, and the Lamb was its light. 🌞✨
21.24: The nations of those who are saved will walk in the city's light, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory and honor into it. 👑🌍
21.25: The gates will never be shut, 'cause there's no night there. 🏙️🌙
21.26: People will bring the glory and honor of the nations into it. 🌍🌎🌏
21.27: But nothing unclean, nothing that makes an abomination, or lies, will ever enter it. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's Book of Life will be allowed in. 🐑

22.1: Then the angel showed me a pure river of water—clear as crystal, flowin' from the throne of God and the Lamb. 🌊✨
22.2: In the middle of the street and on both sides of the river, there was the Tree of Life. It bore twelve fruits, each tree producing a different fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations. 🌳🍎
22.3: There won't be no more curse—God's throne and the Lamb's throne gon' be right there in the city, and His servants gon' serve Him. 🙌🏾
22.4: They gon' see His face, and His name gon' be written on their foreheads. 🕊️
22.5: There won't be no night there—no need for a lamp or the sun, 'cause God Himself gon' light up the place. And His people gon' reign forever and ever. 👑🌟
22.6: Then the angel said to me, "These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the holy prophets sent His angel to show His servants what's about to happen."
22.7: "Look, I'm comin' quickly! Blessed is the one who keeps the words of this prophecy!" 🔥📖
22.8: I, John, saw and heard these things. When I saw and heard, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who showed me these things.
22.9: But he said to me, "Don't do that! I'm just a servant like you and your brothers who got the testimony of Jesus. Worship God!" ✋🏽
22.10: And he said, "Don't seal the words of this prophecy, 'cause the time is near."
22.11: "Let the unjust stay unjust, Let the filthy stay filthy, Let the righteous stay righteous, Let the holy stay holy." 🔥🕊️
22.12: "Look, I'm comin' quickly, and My reward is with Me, to give everyone according to their work." 💯
22.13: "I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End, the First and the Last." 🔑
22.14: Blessed are those who keep His commandments, So they can have the right to the Tree of Life And enter through the gates of the city. 🌳🚪
22.15: But outside are the dogs, sorcerers, sexually immoral folks, murderers, idolaters, and all liars. They gon' have their part in the lake of fire." 🔥
22.16: "I, Jesus, have sent My angel to testify these things to you in the churches. I am the Root and Offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star." ✨
22.17: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" Let anyone who hears say, "Come!" Let anyone who thirsts come. Whoever wants to, take the water of life freely. 💧
22.18: I testify to everyone who hears the words of this prophecy: If anyone adds to this, God gon' add the plagues written in this book to them.
22.19: If anyone takes away from the words of this prophecy, God gon' take away their part from the Book of Life, from the holy city, and from what's written in this book.
22.20: The One who testifies to these things says, "Surely I am comin' quickly." Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus! 🙏🏾
22.21: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. ✝️
